AG06.question: Slow turns are now allowed. Plan two timed drills for that case, each confirming what I actually see after setting up and before doing the insertion I know. If I cannot recreate the setup, give two different concrete fallback drills, one for each activity, using familiar turns without inserting.

history.content: My timer is set to 117 seconds. I want to review an insertion I already know, but may not recover the case. For now, do not turn the cube.

inputs.quote: review an insertion I already know

steps.action: Choose one insertion you already know and note its inverse; apply that inverse slowly to set up the familiar case, then stop and visually confirm the pair shape and target slot match that case. ONLY IF the familiar case was verified, insert with the known insertion, then reset the same case with the same inverse and insert again. OTHERWISE, with the cube in its current state, do your known turns slowly and pause after each turn to name one visible change before continuing; end there without inserting, applying an inverse setup, or checking a solved slot.
steps.reason: Confirms the case visually before turning and gives a concrete no-insert fallback using familiar turns.

steps.action: Choose the same known insertion and its inverse; apply the inverse slowly to recreate the familiar case, then pause and check that the pair and target slot visibly match before any insertion turn. ONLY IF the familiar case was verified, insert with the known insertion, reset the same case with the same inverse, and insert once more. OTHERWISE, with the cube as it is, pick one known turn, say aloud what will visibly move before turning, make that slow turn, and compare what actually moved; end there without inserting, applying an inverse setup, or checking a solved slot.
steps.reason: Adds a prediction check before turning and a distinct fallback drill that stays within familiar turns.

inputs.quote: review an insertion I already know

OTHERWISE, for the whole activity do only your own known turns slowly, pausing after each turn to observe which visible pieces changed, and end there without inserting, inverse setup or solved-slot checks.
steps.reason: Confirms the case visually before turning and gives a concrete known-turn fallback if the setup cannot be recreated.

steps.action: Choose the same insertion and its inverse; apply the inverse slowly to set up the familiar case, then stop and visually confirm the pair shape and target slot before turning. OTHERWISE, for the whole activity pick one known turn, predict aloud which visible pieces will move, perform that turn slowly, and compare the prediction with what actually moved; repeat with other known turns and end there without inserting, inverse setup or solved-slot checks.
steps.reason: Adds a prediction check before each known turn so the fallback stays concrete and distinct from the first drill.

AG08.question: Make a 144–169-word practice plan for my existing Gaelic word list. Give two activities with two timed substeps apiece, limit the whole plan to 179 seconds, and give a reason for each step. At retry, practise only errors if there were any, otherwise use the whole list.

inputs.quote: Make a 144–169-word practice plan for my existing Gaelic word list.

steps.action: With the Gaelic word list open, cover the meaning column, say each meaning aloud, then uncover to check and recover it before the next word.
steps.reason: Covering the answer forces genuine recall, and immediate checking corrects errors before they harden.

steps.action: Cover the meaning column again and repeat every missed word; if none were missed, repeat the whole list once.
steps.reason: Repeating only errors targets weak items, while the whole-list fallback keeps a clean run productive.

steps.action: Cover the Gaelic column, read each meaning, write the Gaelic word on paper, then uncover to check and cover it again.
steps.reason: Writing before checking tests production and gives a visible record of which Gaelic forms are uncertain.

steps.action: Cover the Gaelic column and rewrite only the words you got wrong; if there were none, rewrite the full list once.
steps.reason: A focused error repeat strengthens exactly the forms that failed, with the full list as the no-error alternative.

inputs.quote: Make a 144–169-word practice plan for my existing Gaelic word list.

steps.action: Keep the WORD column visible, cover MEANING, say each meaning, then uncover to check and recover MEANING before the next word; if no list exists, stop.
steps.reason: Covering the answer forces genuine recall, and immediate checking corrects errors before they harden.

steps.action: Cover MEANING again, attempt every word once more, and mark misses; if there were errors, repeat only those, otherwise use the whole list.
steps.reason: A second covered pass strengthens weak items and confirms which words still need attention.

steps.action: Keep MEANING visible, cover WORD, write each Gaelic word on paper, then uncover to check and recover WORD before the next attempt.
steps.reason: Producing the word from its meaning tests spelling and retrieval, while covering prevents copying.

steps.action: Cover WORD again, rewrite every item, and mark misses; if there were errors, repeat only those, otherwise use the whole list.
steps.reason: Rewriting from memory with the answer hidden consolidates accurate spelling and exposes remaining gaps.

AG13.question: 已经做好的双面卡，正面是瑞典语拼法，一翻过来是中文释义。给两项回忆练习并各标明秒数，总计不超过九十六秒。两项都从中文提示默写，翻面查看拼法以后把同一张卡放回中文朝上。

inputs.quote: 已经做好的双面卡，正面是瑞典语拼法，一翻过来是中文释义。

steps.action: 把全部卡片中文面朝上摊开，逐张看中文释义，在纸上默写对应的瑞典语拼法；写完一张就翻面核对拼法，然后立刻把这张卡放回中文朝上，再处理下一张。若卡片不足两张或为零，就用现有卡片按同样方式完成，没有卡片则本项直接结束。
steps.reason: 从中文提示回忆拼法属于产出型词汇练习，先写后翻能检验真实回忆，翻完放回中文朝上保证下一张仍从中文提示开始。

steps.action: 把上一项中拼写有误的卡片挑出，中文面朝上，重新默写瑞典语拼法，翻面核对后放回中文朝上；若上一项没有错误，则从全部卡片中任选若干张，按同样方式再默写一遍。
steps.reason: 针对错误再写一遍能强化薄弱词形，无错误时用全部卡片复练可巩固记忆，两种情形都保持中文提示、翻面核对、放回中文朝上的流程。

inputs.quote: 已经做好的双面卡，正面是瑞典语拼法，一翻过来是中文释义。

steps.action: 把全部卡片中文释义朝上摊开，逐张看中文，在纸上默写对应的瑞典语拼法；写完一张就翻面核对拼法，再把这张卡放回中文朝上，继续下一张。若卡片不足两张，就用现有卡片按同样方式做完一轮。
steps.reason: 从中文提示回忆拼法属于产出型词汇练习，先写后翻能检验真实记忆，翻完复位保证下一轮仍从中文提示开始。

steps.action: 对照上一轮写下的拼法，把写错或没写出的卡片挑出，中文朝上逐张重写拼法，翻面核对后放回中文朝上；若上一轮没有错误，就把全部卡片中文朝上再默写一轮，同样翻面核对后复位。
steps.reason: 针对错误再练能强化薄弱词，无错误时用整轮复习保持记忆，两种分支都以中文朝上收尾。

AG12.question: 手头有两张空白卡和两组词 cedar=雪松、fir=冷杉。给两项各有两小步的练习，合计不超过一百三十二秒，每步最多四十一秒。第一项写两面并回忆，第二项先看中文写英文，再翻面核对。

steps.action: 在两张空白卡上分别写 cedar 与 fir：正面写英文单词，背面写对应中文“雪松”“冷杉”，写完翻回正面

steps.action: 把两张卡翻到中文背面，只看“雪松”“冷杉”，在纸上分别写出 cedar 和 fir

steps.action: 翻到英文正面核对刚写的两个词，逐字比对拼写；全对就收卡结束，有错就把错词在纸上重写一遍再收卡
steps.reason: 用卡片正面作为标准答案核对，并按错误数量决定是否补写
